disagreements.title: Pick-up calendar has no month or year label
disagreements.a_reason: The calendar is a three-week window starting today and the chosen-day line names the month; nothing in the review shows a member picking the wrong day because of it.
disagreements.b_reason: Members choosing a collection day see bare dates with no month or year, and the month is named only after they pick. A small but real orientation problem for a date decision.

disagreements.title: Dark theme drops the chip on green badges
disagreements.a_reason: The green badge sits directly on the card surface in dark mode, the same dark token fault that gives D04's #2f7d4a on #1d2622 at 3.1:1; same badge, same theme.
disagreements.b_reason: Only a shape inconsistency between the two badge variants, and the availability text still shows. The item does not raise the badge's legibility (D04).

disagreements.title: Pick-up calendar has no month label
disagreements.a_reason: As F-0117: a rolling window from today whose chosen day is confirmed with its month; no basis for harm.
disagreements.b_reason: The same orientation gap as F-0117. The month is named only after a day is chosen.

disagreements.title: Dark theme: green badges lose their pill
disagreements.a_reason: The 'plain green text' it describes is D04's #2f7d4a badge text sitting on the dark card surface; same badge, same token fault.
disagreements.b_reason: The same shape inconsistency as F-0120. It does not raise legibility.

assertions.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
